question: Which highly drought-tolerant varieties have viable stock available, meaning at least one lot with quantity above zero whose most recent germination rate is at least 75%? Give the local names.
final_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT sv.local_name
FROM SeedVariety sv
JOIN SeedLot sl ON sl.variety_id = sv.variety_id
JOIN (
    SELECT gt.lot_id, gt.germination_rate
    FROM GerminationTest gt
    JOIN (
        SELECT lot_id, MAX(test_date) AS max_date
        FROM GerminationTest
        GROUP BY lot_id
    ) latest ON gt.lot_id = latest.lot_id AND gt.test_date = latest.max_date
) latest_gt ON latest_gt.lot_id = sl.lot_id
WHERE sv.drought_tolerance = 'High'
  AND sl.quantity > 0
  AND latest_gt.germination_rate >= 75;

question: Which seed lots are viable stock, meaning quantity above zero and a most recent germination rate of at least 75%?
final_sql:
SELECT sl.lot_id,
       sl.variety_id,
       sl.storage_location,
       sl.quantity,
       sl.collection_date,
       gt.germination_rate
FROM SeedLot sl
JOIN (
    SELECT lot_id,
           MAX(test_date) AS latest_date
    FROM GerminationTest
    GROUP BY lot_id
) AS latest ON sl.lot_id = latest.lot_id
JOIN GerminationTest gt
  ON gt.lot_id = latest.lot_id
 AND gt.test_date = latest.latest_date
WHERE sl.quantity > 0
  AND gt.germination_rate >= 75;

            gt.germination_rate

            GerminationTest gt

    ) latest_gt
    ON sl.lot_id = latest_gt.lot_id
WHERE
    sl.quantity > 0
    AND latest_gt.germination_rate >= 75
GROUP BY
    sv.crop_type;

question: For each seed lot with any out-of-range storage reading (temperature above 15 C or humidity above 50%), what is its most recent germination rate?
final_sql:
WITH LotsWithBadStorage AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT lot_id
    FROM StorageLog
    WHERE temperature > 15 OR humidity > 50
),
LatestTest AS (
    SELECT g.lot_id,
           g.germination_rate,
           g.test_date,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY g.lot_id ORDER BY g.test_date DESC) AS rn
    FROM GerminationTest g
)
SELECT l.lot_id,
       lt.germination_rate,
       lt.test_date
FROM LotsWithBadStorage l
JOIN LatestTest lt
  ON l.lot_id = lt.lot_id
WHERE lt.rn = 1;

JOIN SeedLot sl ON sv.variety_id = sl.variety_id
JOIN (
    SELECT lot_id, MAX(test_date) AS last_test_date
    FROM GerminationTest
    GROUP BY lot_id
) lt ON sl.lot_id = lt.lot_id
JOIN GerminationTest gt ON gt.lot_id = lt.lot_id
    AND gt.test_date = lt.last_test_date
WHERE sl.quantity > 0
  AND gt.germination_rate >= 75
GROUP BY sv.crop_name
HAVING SUM(sl.quantity) > 3000;

question: For each seed lot with any out-of-range storage reading (temperature above 15 C or humidity above 50%), what is its most recent germination rate?
final_sql:
WITH LotsWithBadStorage AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT lot_id
    FROM StorageLog
    WHERE temperature > 15 OR humidity > 50
),
LatestTest AS (
    SELECT g.lot_id,
           g.germination_rate,
           g.test_date,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY g.lot_id ORDER BY g.test_date DESC) AS rn
    FROM GerminationTest g
)
SELECT l.lot_id,
       lt.germination_rate,
       lt.test_date
FROM LotsWithBadStorage l
JOIN LatestTest lt
  ON l.lot_id = lt.lot_id
WHERE lt.rn = 1;
